Initial release of loop-stability-check skill.

- Provides a structured protocol to assess and intervene in unstable workflow loops.
- Detects patterns such as repeated retries, oscillation, drift, and wasted cycles in human-bot workflows.
- Defines a disciplined six-part output contract for consistent, actionable analysis.
- Recommends targeted guardrails and interventions to restore workflow stability.
- Clarifies boundaries to avoid misuse in creative or open-ended workflows.
